name: 벤포드 법칙
description: Tests pixel 기울기 분포s against Benfords Law - a 통계적 principle that natural data follows a specific first-digit 분포. AI 생성 기울기s deviate from this 패턴.
mechanism: 분석합니다 first significant digits in DCT 계수 of 8x8 image blocks. Natural images follow Benfords Law, while AI 생성 images deviate from this 통계적 property.
parameters: 블록 크기: 8x8, DCT 계수: AC terms, Test: chi2 goodness-of-fit
accuracy: 중간 - 65-75%, best as complementary 통계적 test
source: Fu et al. (2007) Generalized Benfords Law for JPEG Coefficients, IEEE TIFS
useCase: Statistical validation of image naturalness through digit 분포

references.title: Fu, D. et al. (2007). Generalized Benford's Law for JPEG Coefficients. IEEE TIFS.
Perez-Gonzalez, F. et al. (2007). Benford's Law in Image Forensics. IEEE ICIP.

strengths:
• Based on well-established mathematical law
• Fast computation with minimal overhead
• Independent of image content type
• Effective complementary 통계적 test
limitations:
• Lower standalone 정확도 (65-75%)
• JPEG 압축 can mask deviations
• Requires sufficient image complexity
• Not effective for very small images
